name: thread
description: One system that drives work through time: thread continuity verbs (/thread:open, /thread:next, /thread:orient, /thread:stash, /thread:defer, /thread:handoff, /thread:close) plus the rollout queue engine (/thread:schedule, /thread:execute, /thread:status, /thread:repair, /thread:retro).

plugins.name: thread
plugins.description: Continuity family (open/next/orient/stash/defer/handoff/close: durable thread state, Obsidian captures, routing, orient's reshuffle into phased tasks) + rollout family (schedule/execute/status/repair/retro: a queue of tasks, three-layer convergence, each approved task integrated with the latest main, then auto-merged). The execution-fit test decides which lane owns a cluster.
